newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 26.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Nationalist, Democratic Progressive parties reach consensus on constitutional amendment propsoals
--Government not to raise ceiling on foreign investment in Taiwan's stock market

UNITED DAILY NEWS - Nationalist, Democratic Progressive parties agree to cooperate in phasing out Taiwan provincial government and removing legislators rights to exercise consent on presidential appointment of premier
--China to allow Taiwan's representative offices in Hong Kong to continue operation after handover; accuses Taiwan of trying to bring disorder in Hong Kong on July 1
LIBERTY TIMES - Economics ministry to investigate how son of Formosa Plastics group chairman Wang Yung-ching transfered funds to China to fund four of his reported US$300 million projects there
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Taiwan firms, including Formosa Taffeta, lose heavily on investment in Thailand's stock market
--Taiwan exports to United States increase, but those to Hong Kong drop
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Prosecutors bar Yieh Loong Steel chairman from leaving Taiwan for alleged stock market listing irregularities
--Formosa Plastics' sixth naphtha cracking plant to start quantity production in October
